title: The case is lovely,  pillow is a rock
text: The case is lovely,  pillow is a rock. The outside is velvety and luxurious,  the "pillow" is hard as a rock.  It zips open and what I thought was going to be memory foam is unlike any memory foam i've come across.  Almost plastic feeling to it.  Would not recommend.
